question:
Six numbers, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25 and 26 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the number on the face opposite 25.

solution: The logic followed here is :- From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below : As 25 is common on both the dices I and III, it is clear that 21, 23, 24, and 22 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 26 will be opposite to it.
